supplier.catalog_source: SOLIBRA official website and SOLIBRA Chez Vous storefront

import_notes: This is an initial seed catalog, not a supplier price list.
Prices and deposit amounts are intentionally null: configure them in DEPOTPRO using local supplier invoices or verified price lists.

Packaging quantities documented on the official storefront are marked confirmed_storefront; formats published by the brand website but without case quantity are marked confirmed_format_quantity_unknown.
Product availability and packaging may change. Owner/admin can edit, activate, deactivate, add variants and packaging.
For reusable glass bottles/cases, deposit status is marked as needs_verification unless a storefront filter or product listing explicitly confirms it; do not infer a deposit amount.
PET bottles and cans are treated as non-returnable packaging by default, but the owner can override.
